app_fee.value: The application fee is EUR 55 per course route and is non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: the application fee is €55 and is non-refundable

fee_waiver.value: The application fee cannot be waived.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee cannot be waived as this is a mandatory fee required for the submission and assessment of each application.

gre_general.value: No GRE rule found on the university pages; not stated.

toefl_min.value: Standard Trinity requirement (Band B): TOEFL iBT 90 overall with 21 in each section (4.5 overall, 4.0 each section for tests after January 2026). Trinity says exact requirements are set per course.
toefl_min.quote: Band B (Standard entry) | UG & PG Standard requirements | TOEFL iBT (Before January 2026) | 90 overall | 21 in each section | TOEFL iBT (After January 2026) | 4.5 overall | 4.0 in each section

also.quote: Please see our course website for exact requirements for each course.

ielts_min.value: Standard Trinity requirement (Band B): IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each band; courses may set a different band.
ielts_min.quote: Band B (Standard entry) | UG & PG Standard requirements | 6.5 overall | 6.0 in each band

english_waiver.value: Postgraduate applicants whose primary degree was taught wholly in English may request an exemption with a formal letter from the awarding institution; the course director must approve it. India is not named.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants for postgraduate courses who have completed a primary degree through the medium of English may request an exemption from the requirement to present an English proficiency qualification. | The applicant must provide a formal document from the awarding institution clearly stating their prior degree was delivered wholly through English.

notes: Research degrees have two registration periods (September and March); no closing dates apply.
